response.sql: WITH country_avg AS (SELECT c.country, AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins FROM constructorStandings cs JOIN races r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId WHERE c.country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.country), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS m FROM country_avg), above1 AS (SELECT ca.country, ca.avg_wins FROM country_avg ca, overall o WHERE ca.avg_wins > o.m), group2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS m FROM above1), above2 AS (SELECT a.country, a.avg_wins FROM above1 a, group2 g WHERE a.avg_wins > g.m) SELECT AVG(a.avg_wins) AS mean_avg_wins, AVG(a.avg_wins - o.m) AS mean_excess_over_overall, AVG(a.avg_wins - g.m) AS mean_excess_over_group FROM above2 a, overall o, group2 g;
